tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included, so there is no development-only exemption. It is paired with the recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, which means that no host, internal or otherwise, is exempt from HTTPS or from certificate verification.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
